dashboard.when: their home: the next shift with who else is on, the week, what waits for them, announcements

settings.when: how they are told (email and text and which events) and their calendar link

tokens.when: their own access tokens for the two MCP servers

activity.when: recent activity at a restaurant or one shift's or trade's history

my-schedule.when: their own shifts, by week or as a list, with who else is on

team-schedule.when: the published week for a restaurant by day and position

shift-view.when: one shift: when and where, who is on with them, its trade if any, its history, offer or swap or give it

marketplace.when: the shifts that are up — offered and open and given to them — and whether they may take each, with why not

exchange-view.when: one trade: the shift, the claims, the warnings, and to decide it

approvals.when: what waits for a manager: trades, time off, availability, with each trade's warnings

coverage.when: to cover a gap: who could take the shift, fewest hours first, and ask one or several

my-requests.when: their own requests and trades and what became of them

builder.when: a restaurant's week as a grid: staff or positions down and days across, hours per person, labor against the budget, the warnings, the staffing needs

day-view.when: one day by the hour for the floor

shift-edit.when: to change a shift's times or position or person

template-view.when: one template: its shifts by weekday, and start a week from it

availability.when: a person's weekly availability and what waits for approval

time-off.when: time off requested and approved and who is off

balances.when: balances per time-off type and the ledger behind them

staff-list.when: the staff as cards with position and main restaurant

staff-view.when: one person: positions and certifications and hours and time off; pay for whoever may see it

staff-edit.when: to change a person's main restaurant or limits or positions

positions-list.when: a restaurant's positions with their default rate for whoever may see it

certifications.when: a restaurant's certification kinds and who is expired or due or missing one or has one to verify

certification-kind-add.when: to add a certification kind to a restaurant

certification-kind-edit.when: to change a certification kind: its name and expiry and warning days and the positions that need it

my-certifications.when: their own certifications on the phone — see them and add one and correct one

forecast.when: the covers expected per day-part and the staffing ratios, with the headcount they call for

budget.when: the weekly labor budget against what is scheduled

announcements-list.when: the live announcements for a restaurant

site-settings.when: a restaurant's week and trade settings and reminders and time off hours per day and overtime

time-off-types.when: the time-off types and the blackout dates

rules.when: the rules the restaurant runs and each one's severity

reports.when: hours and labor against budget and open shifts unfilled and trades and overtime and overrides — each as a table and a CSV
